about: THE SITE-WIDE MEDIA CONTRACT (Owner, 26 Sep 2026 · the Media Asset Agent). Every Owner collection of the Drive media library that the website uses — the numbered folder, each source by its stable Drive file id, what it is, where on the website it stands (route · component · role), the local delivery asset, the focal point per viewport class and the last synchronised source state. The roles are the website's display contracts, measured from the rendered components: a source's own aspect ratio never redefines the layout. src/media/agent.mjs is the engine, src/media/media-qa.mjs the gate (release gate M2), docs/MEDIA-ASSET-AGENT.md the manual. Never served (src/ is outside the Worker's assets) — no Drive id or URL reaches a page.

library.title: H&S media library
library.rule: '999 - Archive' is the Owner's private working area and permanently outside the agent's authority: it is excluded in the very query that lists the library (not title contains 'Archive' / '999') and never opened, listed, searched, compared, downloaded or used — not even read-only.
library.folderIds: local only: src/media-library.private.json (the library root and each collection folder; git-ignored as src/*.private.json, never committed) — the agent lists a folder by it, read-only

hero-slide.behaviour: slideshow: a photograph holds 3 s; a film plays over its poster, always starting muted, and the show moves on at its end; Play / Pause on every film, Sound on / Mute only with an audio track; reduced motion starts nothing (assets/hero-show.js)

destination-film.component: .a-dest > .am[data-video] — a city chapter's ambient film over its photograph
destination-film.behaviour: a silent ambient film over its photograph (assets/aman.js: muted loop, no controls, aria-hidden, pauses off screen, the photograph on reduced motion or Save-Data); the file keeps the source sound, the module never plays it

destination-clip.component: .a-dest .a-clip[data-clip] — a city chapter's editorial film (Lijiang: Impression Lijiang)
destination-clip.behaviour: the editorial clip (assets/clip.js): muted by itself, Play / Pause always, Sound on / Mute only with an audio track; the guest's own tap alone may unmute

destination-gallery-item.behaviour: a rail of 3 : 4 photographs, one visual row; the frame is the gallery's, never the source's

card.component: .acar .aslide .am — a destination, journey or stay card
card.behaviour: a 5 : 4 card photograph; a destination card may carry an ambient film (assets/aman.js: muted loop, no controls, aria-hidden) — the file keeps the source sound, the module never plays it

journey-card-gallery.behaviour: a 5 : 4 card gallery, one frame at a time

editorial-pair.behaviour: a still photograph beside its text column

venue-map.behaviour: the aerial shown whole at its own ratio (Owner, 22 Sep 2026) — never cover-cropped (the stage chooses the wide or the tall frame of the same aerial)

product-gallery.behaviour: a product's photographs, 1 / n, arrows and swipe

room-gallery.component: .gal .ph — a room's or a leg's gallery
room-gallery.behaviour: a product page's photographs, 1 / n, arrows and swipe

experience-film.behaviour: the editorial clip (assets/clip.js): muted by itself, Play / Pause, Sound on / Mute only with an audio track

venue-zone-photo.component: .venue-photo — a venue place's photograph in the venue stage (assets/venue.js)
venue-zone-photo.behaviour: a 4 : 3 photograph, cover, centred; thumbnails switch it

editorial-band.component: .a-band — a full-width photograph band between sections
editorial-band.behaviour: a fixed-height band, cover, centred — the widest crop on the site
